NLP / TRANSFORMERS

Automatic Meeting Summarizer

From a long conversation to a concise summary.

PythonPyTorchTransformersFlaskPegasus
Explore the repository ↗
Problem

Why this project?

Meeting transcripts contain useful information, but their length can make the key points difficult to revisit. This project explores generating a shorter summary from a supplied text transcript.

Approach

From input to output.

The repository includes fine-tuning notebooks for T5, LED, BART, and Pegasus. Its Flask application uses a locally loaded fine-tuned Pegasus model to generate summaries through a web interface.

Implementation
01

Model exploration

Separate notebooks support experimentation with four transformer architectures for summarization.

02

Web interface

A Flask endpoint receives transcript text and returns the generated summary as JSON.

03

Inference pipeline

The application uses PyTorch, selects CUDA when available, and applies generation settings to control length and repetition.

What to keep in mind

The current web application tokenizes at most 512 input tokens, so longer transcripts are truncated. It expects local fine-tuned model files that are not included in the listed repository files. Generated summaries should be checked against the original transcript.
